rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE PRACTICE OF OCCUPATIONAL THERAPY IN THE PHILIPPINES, AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Regulating The Practice Of Occupational Therapy In The Philippines
rows.abstract:
Creates the Professional Regulatory Board of Occupational Therapy that shall promulgate rules and regulations, administrative orders, and issuances to carry out the provisions of this Act; supervise and regulate the registration, licensure, and practice of occupational therapy in the country; prescribe the Code of Ethics and Standards of Practice for occupational therapists and occupational therapy technicians; and issue, suspend, revoke and reinstate the certificate of registration and professional identification card for the practice of occupational therapy, among others.

Requires all applicants for registration for the practice of occupational therapy to undergo a licensure examination to be administered by the Board; and prescribes prohibitions on the practice of occupational therapy.

Proposes all registered occupation therapists to become members of one national professional organization of occupational therapists duly registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
rows.status: Republic Act RA11241 enacted on 2019-03-11

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE PRACTICE OF SPEECH LANGUAGE PATHOLOGY IN THE PHILIPPINES, AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Regulating The Practice Of Speech Language Pathology In The Philippines
rows.abstract:
Creates the Professional Regulatory Board of Speech Language Pathology under the supervision of the Professional Regulatory Commission that shall promulgate rules and regulations; administer oaths; supervise and regulate; and develop and maintain standards for the practice of speech language pathology in the country.

Requires licensure examination for all applicants for the practice of speech language pathology who must obtain a general weighted average of at least seventy-five percent (75%) with no grade lower than fifty percent (50%) in any given subject of examination.

Requires the Speech Language Pathology Board to maintain a roster of speech language pathologists which shall contain the names of the speech language pathologists, their respective certificate of registration numbers, and other data which the Board may deem pertinent.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE SPACE DEVELOPMENT AND UTILIZATION POLICY AND CREATING THE PHILIPPINE SPACE AGENCY, DEFINING THE PURPOSE AND SCOPE OF ITS ACTIVITIES, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Establishing The Philippine Space Development And Utilization Policy And Creating The Philippine Space Agency, Defining The Purpose And Scope Of Its Activities
rows.abstract:
Seeks to establish a Philippine Space Policy that will serve as the country´s primary strategic roadmap for space development and embody the country´s central goal of becoming a space-capable and space-faring nation. 

Provides for a framework that will focus on six (6) Key Development Areas (KDA) for Space Science and Technology Applications (SSTA) development to ensure the country´s sustained progress: National Security and Development; Hazard Management and Climate Studies; Space Research and Development; Space Industry Capacity Building; Space Education and Awareness; and International Cooperation

Creates and mandates the Philippine Space Authority (PhilSA) to be the primary entity of the Executive Branch of the government that will plan, develop, and promote the national space program in line with the Philippine Space Policy.

Creates the Philippine Space Development Fund that shall be sourced from the share of the National Government in the gross income of PAGCOR and the BCDA; income from specialized products, services, and royalties produced by PhilSA; and loans, contributions, grants, bequests, gifts, and donations from local or foreign sources.
rows.status: Republic Act RA11363 enacted on 2019-08-08

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE FIRST DAY OF FEBRUARY OF EVERY YEAR AS NATIONAL HIJAB DAY
rows.title_short: Declaring The First Day Of February Of Every Year As \"national Hijab Day\"
rows.abstract:
Encourages government institutions, private sectors and schools to observe the National Hijab Day to promote understanding and awareness among its employees and students as to the value of wearing the hijab.

Mandates the National Commission on Muslim Filipinos to be the lead agency in the promotion and raising consciousness about Hijabis in the Philippines and to conduct educational drive and information dissemination campaign to effectively meet the objectives of this Act.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2018-12-04, transmitted to the Senate on 2018-12-06 and received by the Senate on 2018-12-06
